verdict.rationale: Chronicle's environment docs say a custom environment version can describe MCP servers alongside replays, datastores and twins. That means MCP servers can be plugged into its simulated worlds so the agent under test can call their tools. There is no evidence that Chronicle's own AI features (e.g., Worldsmith) consume MCP tools, and the mention is a single line with no setup detail. missing for 10: documentation of how MCP servers are registered or configured, evidence that the product's own agentic features use MCP tools, supported transports or auth details, hands-on or independent corroboration.
